posts.title: Move More: Active Breaks at Work!
posts.excerpt: Stand up and walk for 5 minutes every hour. Small active breaks improve circulation, reduce stress, and boost productivity. Take care of your body!

posts.title: Hydrate: Focus and Daily Energy!
posts.excerpt: Drink water regularly to maintain focus and energy. Always keep a water bottle nearby. Proper hydration improves your concentration and workplace well-being.

posts.excerpt: Bebe agua regularmente para mantener el enfoque y la energía. Ten siempre una botella cerca. La hidratación adecuada mejora tu concentración y bienestar laboral.

posts.title: Postura Correta: Evite Dores e Desconforto!
posts.excerpt: Ajuste sua cadeira e monitor para uma postura ergonômica. Mantenha os pés no chão e as costas retas. Uma boa postura previne dores e melhora seu bem-estar diário.

posts.title: Correct Posture: Avoid Pain and Discomfort!
posts.excerpt: Adjust your chair and monitor for ergonomic posture. Keep your feet on the floor and your back straight. Good posture prevents pain and improves your daily well-being.

posts.title: Postura Correcta: ¡Evita Dolores y Molestias!
posts.excerpt: Ajusta tu silla y monitor para una postura ergonómica. Mantén los pies en el suelo y la espalda recta. Una buena postura previene dolores y mejora tu bienestar diario.
